title: Marines fire Rocket Propelled Grenades
description: Rocket Propelled Grenades are one of the biggest threats for Marine aircraft. Sgt. Ricardo Gomez takes us to Camp Leatherneck, where Marines with 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing are learning all about these deadly weapons.
